editorial.blurb: Truffle is a spirited neighborhood spot where attentive service and bold American comfort food shine, especially when you arrive with reservations and an open mind.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation and arrive on time—the space is genuinely tiny with limited waiting area. Order the honey buffalo shrimp and buffalo salmon bites, and ask for sauces on the side if you prefer to control the seasoning.

topDishes.note: Consistently praised as the standout, perfectly seasoned
Crunchy outside, tender inside, excellent without extra sauce
Flavorful when cooked to order, worth requesting medium-well specifically
